hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; { [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ] && "$d/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
